item.title: 4 men plead guilty to torching 4 London-based ambulances operated by Jewish charity
item.description: Four men have pleaded guilty to destroying four Jewish community ambulances in an arson attack in north London earlier this year that many said was a direct result of the start of the Iran war

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln sails past Singapore on its way home from Middle East
item.description: The U.S. aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln has sailed past Singapore as it heads home

item.title: Trump's Greenland threats cast a shadow on Iceland's vote on whether to trigger EU membership talks
item.description: Voters in Iceland are deciding whether to resume negotiations to join the EU.

item.title: Russian attack hits Ukraine's Kyiv region, killing at least 27
item.description: Ukrainian officials say at least 37 people have been killed in a Russian strike on a warehouse near Kyiv that may have been illegally storing munitions in a residential area

item.title: Nepal warns of more possible floods as communities grapple with devastation
item.description: Authorities in Nepal are warning of possible fresh flooding and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River

item.title: Russian drones batter Ukraine's Kyiv region, hitting apartments and warehouses for a second day
item.description: Russian forces have resumed drone attacks on Ukraine’s Kyiv region, hitting numerous buildings and storage depots
